d: The Training Manager is a role responsible for overseeing the training and development programs within the Service Operations. This position involves designing and implementing comprehensive training initiatives, managing a team of trainers, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure the effectiveness of training programs in meeting business objectives. The Training Manager also supervises a Training Team Leader who assists in coordinating and delivering training activities.
r: Develop and execute a strategic training plan that aligns with the Service Operations goals and objectives.
Conduct thorough needs assessments to identify training gaps and develop targeted learning solutions.
Collaborate with subject matter experts and stakeholders to gather insights and ensure training content is accurate and relevant.
Design and develop training materials, including manuals, presentations, e-learning modules, and job aids.
Apply instructional design principles to ensure effective knowledge transfer and skill development.
Lead and manage a team of trainers and a Training Team Leader, providing guidance, support, and mentorship.
Set clear performance expectations and goals for trainers and the Training Team Leader.
Conduct regular performance evaluations and provide ongoing coaching to enhance their professional growth.
Foster a positive and collaborative team environment, encouraging knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
Develop and implement evaluation methods to assess the effectiveness of training programs.
Analyze training evaluation data to identify areas for improvement and make recommendations for enhancements.
Collaborate with the Quality Assurance team to align training outcomes with quality standards.
Ensure compliance with training requirements and regulatory guidelines.
Collaborate with Contact Center supervisors, operations managers, and other stakeholders to identify training needs and align training initiatives with business objectives.
Participate in cross-functional meetings and projects to provide training expertise and support.
Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication and collaboration.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date training records and documentation.
Oversee the training schedule and logistics, ensuring smooth execution of training programs.
Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in training and adult learning methodologies.
Research and recommend new tools and technologies to enhance training delivery and efficiency.
Deliver high-impact training sessions to Service Operations agents and other staff members.
Utilize a variety of instructional methods and techniques to accommodate different learning styles.
Ensure training sessions are aligned with established learning objectives and address identified training needs.
Continuously monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training delivery, making adjustments as necessary to enhance outcomes.
Provide coaching and feedback to trainers and the Training Team Leader to improve their facilitation skills.

Strategy & Transactions (SaT) is recruiting for a Valuations Manager to assist our MENA based Oil and Gas clients in addressing their strategic planning, regulatory compliance, financial reporting and fair market value documentation needs. You’ll have the opportunity to develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring and formal learning.
q: Individuals who will strive to deliver valuations on time and within budget will do well in this environment. You will also be required to take ownership of your career by obtaining regular feedback on a timely basis and keeping alert to learning and development opportunities. You'll actively establish and develop external and internal relationships, helping to create a positive learning culture within the team.
bachelor's degree in finance, economics, accounting, or business.
At least 5 years of valuation work experience with Oil and Gas/Energy clients.
Experience managing valuation projects for M&A, Purchase Price Allocations, and Fair Valuations.
Financial modeling skills, including building and reviewing models for Energy businesses.
Proven ability to write and own valuation reports for M&A and Financial Reporting.
r: As a Valuations Manager, you'll make technical contributions to valuation and modelling on client engagements and internal projects. You'll be working on large Oil and Gas clients and will gain a thorough understanding of the subject businesses, markets and of clients' issues, performing research and analysis of the target's industry and of quoted companies operating in the sector. You'll deal with day-to-day queries raised by clients and will attend internal and external meetings relating to the assignment.

You'll perform valuation calculations and analyses, as well as being involved in drafting presentations and reports, formulating views on value, presenting conclusions to the rest of the team and contributing to the presentations of our work and findings to the client.
Have hunger to grow and develop professionally.
Have valuation experience in a professional services/Big 4 firm.
Have experience in a consulting environment and working with large clients.
Made progress towards a CFA, CA, or other professional qualification.

We are looking for candidates who are highly motivated, analytical, logical thinkers with a passion for valuations and have a very strong attention to detail. Being a strong team player is critical with the ability to adapt to changing requirements or deadlines in support of our clients goals.
